verdict.rationale: Poke documents its own API for sending messages programmatically, which reaches its conversational core (anything you could ask Poke by text). A CLI also covers some setup tasks: login, adding MCP servers, tunnels and recipe creation. There is no evidence that account, subscription, integration management or Kitchen/payout actions are exposed programmatically, and no OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: documented API coverage of integration connect/disconnect, subscription/credits, recipe publishing and payouts, memory and account management; a published API reference/OpenAPI spec; independent corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Poke API allows you to send messages programmatically from your applications, scripts, and automation tools.
npx poke@latest mcp add https://mcp.example.com/sse -n "My Server"
With --recipe, the CLI creates a connection and returns a recipe link and QR code in the terminal.
